capabilities: Track work hours with a built-in start/stop timer
Show a color-coded flextime balance, weekly progress, and statistics
Register absences and track leave usage against yearly quotas
Import and export time data as CSV, JSON, or Timekeep format
Create and manage custom note types with templates and folders
extras: Data and settings are stored in a timekeep-format code block in timeflow/data.md, so settings sync with whatever vault sync the user already runs. Installation via the BRAT beta plugin is documented as an alternative to manual install.
motivation: The author originally built it as a dataview script that used Timekeep data for tracking time, then converted it into a full plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log work hours, track a flextime balance, or manage vacation and sick-leave quotas.

relations.evidence: Originally a dataview script that used TimeKeep data for tracking time.

summary: Flextime tracking dashboard with a built-in timer, color-coded balance, calendar, leave quotas, statistics, and CSV/JSON import and export.
